{{Quote|If you had lived as long as I have, Thanaton, you would not revere the past so unquestioningly.|Darth Mortis|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Darth Mortis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] who served on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] ruling [[Dark Council]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. One of the twelve Dark Lords who sat on the Council, Mortis presided over the [[Sphere of Laws and Justice]]. Mortis trained at least one [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Zavrasha]], and he was committed to ensuring that the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] remained in place, though he assumed a leadership role alongside [[Darth Marr]] and [[Darth Ravage]] as the Dark Council's numbers thinned throughout the [[Galactic War]] with the Republic.

==Biography==
Darth Mortis was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who had risen to the rank of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Empire]] by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The older man was sufficiently powerful enough to be granted a seat on the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]], and as one of the twelve [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]]<ref name="The Dark Council">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|The Dark Council|Korriban}}</ref> he controlled a [[Spheres of Influence|Sphere of Influence]] within the Empire: specifically, Mortis controlled the [[Sphere of Laws and Justice]]. As head of the Sphere, Mortis was charged with overseeing the Imperial justice system and those branches of the Empire that maintained the law within its society.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> By the end of the Cold War, Mortis had also begun training a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] named [[Zavrasha]], and he dispatched her to the neutral [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in order to ensure that [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Jefand Ange]]'s efforts there did not endanger the peace brought about by the [[Treaty of Coruscant]].<ref name="Shattering the Peace" /> The Sith Lord [[Darth Gravus]], who was placed in charge of the [[Invasion of Taris|invasion]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], was a political ally of Mortis.<ref name="Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref>

===Galactic War begins===
{{Quote|I'm sorry, Thanaton&hellip;|Darth Mortis, before breaking Darth Thanaton's neck|<ref name="TOR" />}}
[[File:Darth_Mortis.png|thumb|left|240px|Darth Mortis looking upon Darth Thanaton after telekinetically snapping his neck.]]
As the [[Galactic War]] broke out with the Republic, Darth Mortis and the other members of the Council were summoned by fellow Councilor [[Darth Baras]] to their [[Dark Council Chambers|meeting chamber]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Decimus|Decimus]], [[Darth Hadra|Hadra]], and [[Darth Acharon|Acharon]] were overseeing the [[Battle of Corellia]], so the three attended via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. [[Darth Marr|Darths Marr]] and [[Darth Ravage|Ravage]] were present on Korriban with Mortis, where Baras attempted to declare himself the [[Emperor's Voice (Sith Empire)|Voice of the Emperor]]&mdash;the public extension of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] will and thereby the ruler of the entire Empire. However, Baras was interrupted by the arrival of [[Darth Vowrawn]] and Baras' [[Empire's Wrath|former apprentice]]. The [[Sith Warrior]], who had been appointed as the [[Emperor's Wrath]] after Baras had betrayed his student, [[Duel in the Dark Council Chambers (Galactic War)|battled]] the false Voice before the rest of the Council.<ref name="The Dark Council" />

After the Wrath killed Baras, Darth Vowrawn led Mortis and the others in acknowledging the truth of the Emperor's support for the warrior, accepting that the Wrath was not bound by the Council's wishes. When the Wrath departed, [[Darth Thanaton]] brought his own matter before his fellow Councilors: the head of the [[Sphere of Ancient Knowledge]] was engaged in a [[Kaggath (Galactic War)|Kaggath]], an ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ritual duel, against his rival and subordinate Lord [[Darth Nox|Kallig]]. After being bested by Kallig on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Thanaton appealed to Mortis, Ravage, Vowrawn, and Marr to eliminate the upstart [[Slavery/Legends|slave]], though the other Dark Councilors refused to interfere when Kallig arrived to continue their [[Duel in the Dark Council Chambers (Kaggath)|battle]]. After Kallig defeated Thanaton and forced him to submit, Mortis rose from his seat and apologized to his fellow Councilor before breaking his neck with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Acknowledging Kallig as the victor, the four Dark Councilors present rewarded the young Sith Lord with Thanaton's now-vacant seat on the Council, and they brushed off the newly-appointed [[Darth Nox]]'s question when the Emperor would meet with the Council. As the Council adjourned, Mortis advised Nox to return Dromund Kaas and ensure the loyalty of their followers, promising to summon Nox the next time the Dark Council congregates.<ref name="The Dark Council" />

===The aftermath of Corellia===
[[File:SithCocktailParty-TOR.png|thumb|right|220px|Darths Vowrawn, Marr, Mortis, and Ravage were among the few surviving Council members after Corellia.]]
After the Battle of Corellia ended with a Republic victory and the deaths of Decimus, Hadra, and Acharon, the Dark Council was angered to learn that the Sith Lord [[Darth Malgus]] declared his [[New Empire|own empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]&mdash;an empire that did not discriminate against [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and was not beholden to the political infighting that the current Empire was. Mortis assumed a leadership role on the Council along with Marr and Ravage, dispatching [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ilyan Regus]] and [[Darth Arho]], Baras' successor as head of the [[Sphere of Military Offense]], to conduct the [[Battle of Ilum|campaign]] against both Malgus and the Republic there.<ref name="The Final Front">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Final Front|Ilum}}</ref> Mortis and the other Councilors would later meet in their [[Dark Council chamber (Dromund Kaas)|chambers]] beneath the [[Imperial Citadel (Sith Empire)|Imperial Citadel]] on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] to debate who would succeed Darth Hadra as the head of the [[Sphere of Technology]], and Mortis was one of several Councilors who refused to support Darth Marr's candidate, the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Darth Karrid]]. Mortis believed that the Empire was wrong in adopting Malgus' policy of allowing aliens to join their ranks, and he proposed the Human traditionalist Darth Gravus in opposition to Karrid. To that end, he tried to convince the rest of the Council to grant Gravus a seat once he [[Second battle of Leritor|reclaimed]] the mineral-rich world of [[Leritor/Legends|Leritor]].<ref name="Annihilation" /> After Karrid disposed of Gravus, Mortis chose to support Karrid, admitting that he had underestimated her.

{{GameDS|Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel}}
During [[Makeb]] invasion by the Hutt Cartel, Darth Mortis summoned an Imperial individual to assist him against [[The Shroud (Human)|The Shroud]], a spy who wanted to plan a rogue attack on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. The Dark Councilor introduced [[Evie Bo]], the ex top-lieutenant of [[The Shroud (Human)|The Shroud]], to the Imperial individual who gave him the microbinoculars in order to find another lieutenant in the city and stop [[The Shroud (Human)|The Shroud]]. After neutralizing the Shroud lieutenant, the Imperial individual traveled across the galaxy to uncover the Shroud's plan. The trail eventually lead to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where Bo and the Imperial individual uncovered the Shroud's plan to launch a ship through hyperspace into Kaas City. The Imperial individual managed to thwart both the attack and kill the Shroud, or so it seemed. When the individual returned to Dromund Kaas, the Shroud hijacked Mortis' holofrequency, revealing that a double was killed in his place. Before signing off, the Shroud used a trigger phrase to activate a neural scrambler in Bo's brain, erasing her memory. As Mortis managed to get through, the individual convinced an amnesiac Bo that she is a servant of the Empire.
{{Endgame}}

===A fractured Council===
In [[3636 BBY]]<ref>{{TOR_updates|4.0}}</ref> the galaxy was invaded by the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]], with [[Darth Marr]] being one of the first victims of the [[Eternal Empire conquest]]. [[Eternal Fleet]] had blockaded Dromund Kaas before the end of the year, and the members of the Dark Council fought the invasion of Zakuulan Emperor [[Arcann]] with ruthlessness, only to lose. The surviving members of the Dark Council went into hiding rather than be destroyed, and [[Darth Acina]] remained the only Dark Councillor left alive and in the public eye, proclaiming herself the Empress of the Sith without opposition. Acina signed a [[Zakuul–Imperial treaty|peace treaty]] with Zakuul and continued to rule with public support for the next six years.<ref name="KOTFE 4">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=4}}</ref> Around [[3630 BBY]]<ref>{{TOR_updates|5.0}}</ref> Zakuul's Empire was defeated by the [[Eternal Alliance]] formed by former [[Minister of Sith Intelligence|Sith Intelligence Minister]] [[Lana Beniko]],<ref name="KOTET 9">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=9}}</ref> and the surviving members of the former Dark Council began to re-emerge, Vowrawn,<ref name="Copero">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|A Traitor Among the Chiss}}</ref> Ravage and Mortis among them.<ref name="Nathema" />

{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
[[File:MortisMeeting.png|thumb|left|240px|Darth Mortis joins the Order of Zildrog.]]
Having prevailed over Zakuul, [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the Eternal Alliance took over the [[Eternal Throne]] and with it control over the massive Eternal Fleet. However, rather than using it to seize control over the galaxy, the Commander instead proclaimed an era of peace and sought to win over new allies with diplomacy. Seeing such massive power wasted, Mortis became disgusted at the Commander's weakness and the betrayal of Lana Beniko, who abandoned the Sith Empire in favor of the Eternal Alliance. Willing to see the Eternal Fleet destroyed if it meant denying it to those undeserving of its power, Mortis joined the [[Order of Zildrog]], a secretive group formed by former [[Horizon Guard]] [[Vinn Atrius]] and dedicated to killing the Outlander and destroying the Eternal Alliance. Persuading Vinn Atrius with his desire for revenge, Mortis traveled with the rest of the Order to [[Nathema]], where [[GEMINI 16]] found and planned to awaken [[Zildrog]], an ancient [[Iokath]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. However, the [[GEMINI]] droid deceived and betrayed many of her allies, locking them inside energy transfer chambers to be used as fuel for Zildrog's awakening. Darth Mortis was among the victims drained to awaken Zildrog, and the Alliance Commander along with Lana Beniko and [[Theron Shan]] arrived shortly after and destroyed the mechanical entity, after which the entire chamber that housed it and the GEMINI's victims exploded.<ref name="Nathema" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Elevating a Falleen to the Council shows other species that there is a place for them in our Empire.''"<br />"''Perhaps the problem is that the other species have forgotten their proper place.|Darth Marr and Darth Mortis|<ref name="Annihilation" />}}
[[File:Darth_Mortis_Force.png|thumb|left|180px|Darth Mortis puts Thanaton out of his misery.]]
A Human male with [[Color/Legends|orange]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], pale skin, and black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], Mortis was among the older members of the Council by the end of the Cold War.<ref name="Retribution" /> He did not place much faith in Sith traditions, though he was a believer in the Empire's anti-alien policies&mdash;something that led him to support Darth Gravus over Darth Karrid when the Dark Council was considering whom to give Darth Hadra's Dark Council seat to.<ref name="Annihilation" /> Nevertheless, he changed his tune when Karrid outmaneuvered and killed Gravus, realizing that he had underestimated her.

==Powers and abilities==
A powerful practitioner of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], Darth Mortis was a master of [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] and [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]].<ref name="The Dark Council" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Mortis is a character in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]], originally appearing only duing the final missions of the [[Sith Warrior]] and [[Sith Inquisitor]]'s respective class storylines on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="Retribution" /><ref name="The Dark Council" /> After the game's release, he was also featured in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', which identified him as the head of the Sphere of Laws and Justice,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and appeared in ''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]'' novel by [[Drew Karpyshyn]] set after the events of the [[Battle of Ilum]]. In [[2013]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']] Mortis plays a significant role in [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]]-related [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] storyline, available for all Imperial classes.

[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] established that all Dark Council members except for [[Darth Acina]] died or disappeared during the [[Eternal Empire conquest]], but Mortis is later revealed to have survived and appears during "The Nathema Conspiracy" flashpoint. He is present only if the player, regardless of their class, made the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light Side]] choice to address the galaxy as a peacekeeper during the very end of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']]. If the player makes the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]] choice to become a new Emperor and use the Eternal Fleet to empower themselves, Mortis has no reason to oppose them, and his place as [[Zildrog]]'s victim is taken by [[Indo Zal]] instead.<ref name="Nathema" />
